Access_Overview.en-US: Open independent, executable access pages. AccessSurface owns their single main landmark; AccessPanel also fits an existing page without adding another main. Forms and all actions remain standard Flourish controls.
Access_Overview.zh-CN: 打开独立且可执行的访问页。AccessSurface 提供唯一的 main 地标；AccessPanel 也可嵌入现有页面而不增加另一个 main。表单与全部动作均使用标准 Flourish 控件。

Access_DemoOnly.en-US: UI demonstration only: use fictitious values, never real credentials. No authentication, network request, token, browser storage or account persistence occurs. Fixture changes last only in this example instance; a reload resets them.
Access_DemoOnly.zh-CN: 仅为 UI 演示：请使用虚构值，切勿输入真实凭据。本页不执行认证或网络请求，不产生令牌，不使用浏览器存储，也不持久化账号。数据只保留在当前示例实例内，刷新即重置。

Access_LoginDescription.en-US: A complete local login composition with field validation, selectable results, visible busy state and disabled actions.
Access_LoginDescription.zh-CN: 完整的本地登录组合，展示字段校验、可选结果、可见忙碌状态与禁用动作。

Access_AccountsDescription.en-US: Choose a fictitious saved email to prefill the login page, remove a fixture, or test the empty and unavailable-account states.
Access_AccountsDescription.zh-CN: 选择虚构的已保存邮箱并预填登录页，移除示例账号，或验证空态与不可用账号状态。

Access_Remember.en-US: Remember this fictitious email in this example only
Access_Remember.zh-CN: 仅在当前示例中记住此虚构邮箱

Access_InvalidEmail.en-US: Use a valid email format, such as visitor@example.invalid.
Access_InvalidEmail.zh-CN: 请输入有效邮箱格式，例如 visitor@example.invalid。

Access_RequiredPassword.en-US: Enter any fictitious password to exercise the required field.
Access_RequiredPassword.zh-CN: 请输入任意虚构密码以验证必填字段。

Access_Accepted.en-US: The success view is shown. No account has been authenticated and no session has been created. If selected, only the email fixture is remembered; the password has been cleared.
Access_Accepted.zh-CN: 已展示成功界面，但未认证任何账号，也未创建会话。若勾选记住选项，仅保留邮箱示例；密码已清空。

Access_Rejected.en-US: The rejected-result view is shown. This is a chosen demonstration state, not a credential check. The password has been cleared; enter another fictitious value to retry.
Access_Rejected.zh-CN: 已展示拒绝结果界面。这是选定的演示状态，并非凭据检查。密码已清空；请输入另一个虚构值后重试。

Access_Unavailable.en-US: The service-error view is shown. No service was contacted. The password has been cleared; choose another demonstration result and retry.
Access_Unavailable.zh-CN: 已展示服务错误界面，但未联系任何服务。密码已清空；可改选演示结果后重试。

Access_InteractiveRequired.en-US: Waiting for the interactive example. Submission stays disabled without JavaScript; this page has no server authentication endpoint.
Access_InteractiveRequired.zh-CN: 正在等待交互示例连接。未启用 JavaScript 时提交保持禁用；本页没有服务端认证入口。

Access_Empty.zh-CN: 没有已保存的示例账号

Access_EmptyDescription.en-US: Continue with another fictitious email or restore the original fixtures.
Access_EmptyDescription.zh-CN: 可使用另一个虚构邮箱，或恢复初始示例数据。

Access_DisabledAccount.en-US: Unavailable fixture. Selection is disabled; removal is still allowed.
Access_DisabledAccount.zh-CN: 不可用示例账号。选择已禁用，但仍可移除。

Access_SelectionRejected.en-US: This example account is unavailable or no longer exists. Choose another account.
Access_SelectionRejected.zh-CN: 此示例账号不可用或已不存在，请选择其他账号。

Access_AccountsChanged.en-US: The example list was changed locally. No real account was modified.
Access_AccountsChanged.zh-CN: 示例列表已在本地更新；没有修改任何真实账号。

Access_Selected.en-US: A saved fixture prefilled this email. Selection alone never signs in; enter a fictitious password to run the local demonstration.
Access_Selected.zh-CN: 已保存示例已预填邮箱。选择账号不会登录；请输入虚构密码运行本地演示。

Access_SurfaceGuide.en-US: AccessSurface renders main and must be the only main landmark in an independent document. This Gallery board already sits inside ApplicationShell.main, so it links to complete executable login and account-selection pages instead of nesting another main. Use AccessPanel inside an existing surface.
Access_SurfaceGuide.zh-CN: AccessSurface 会生成 main，必须作为独立文档中唯一的 main 地标。当前 Gallery 演示板已位于 ApplicationShell.main 内，因此通过链接打开完整、可执行的登录与账号选择页，不再嵌套另一个 main。在已有表面内请使用 AccessPanel。

Display_Intro.en-US: Presentation pages use full-width backgrounds with centered controls. These fictitious examples contain no authentication, licensing or billing behavior.
Display_Intro.zh-CN: 展示页面使用全宽背景与居中控件。这些虚构案例不执行认证、许可或计费行为。

Display_ProductDescription.en-US: Lumen is a fictitious product used to demonstrate library-owned banners, artistic titles, standard actions and a wordmark footer.
Display_ProductDescription.zh-CN: Lumen 是虚构产品，用于演示库内横幅、艺术标题、标准动作和品牌大字页脚。

Display_ContainerExplanation.en-US: The surface fills the available page width. Headings, body text and controls remain in the shared centered container, including narrow screens.
Display_ContainerExplanation.zh-CN: 表面背景铺满可用页面宽度；标题、正文与控件保持在共享的居中限宽容器中，并适配窄屏。

Display_OfferDescription.en-US: Fictitious display data only; no purchase is available.
Display_OfferDescription.zh-CN: 仅为虚构展示数据，不提供购买。

Display_Submitted.en-US: Local demonstration completed. No credentials were sent or validated.
Display_Submitted.zh-CN: 本地演示完成，没有发送或验证任何凭据。

Display_Disclaimer.en-US: Lumen is fictitious · no commercial offer
Display_Disclaimer.zh-CN: Lumen 为虚构品牌 · 非商业报价

Home_FrameworkDescription.en-US: Configure the top bar, navigation, commands and application shell.
Home_FrameworkDescription.zh-CN: 配置顶部栏、导航、命令和页面外壳。

Home_ControlsDescription.en-US: Browse components, variants, APIs and interactive examples.
Home_ControlsDescription.zh-CN: 查看控件目录、变体、用法和交互演示。

Home_FoundationsDescription.en-US: Explore typography, colors, spacing, radius and themes.
Home_FoundationsDescription.zh-CN: 查看字体、颜色、间距、圆角和主题。

Home_ExamplesDescription.en-US: Compose forms, lists, enum selection and search.
Home_ExamplesDescription.zh-CN: 组合表单、列表、枚举选择和搜索。

Home_SetupDescription.en-US: Use ApplicationLayout as the default route layout and create your pages. Design is optional; Framework provides layout and behavior.
Home_SetupDescription.zh-CN: 将路由的默认布局设置为 ApplicationLayout，再创建自己的页面。Design 是可选主题；Framework 提供布局和交互行为。

Localization_Scope.en-US: Changes belong to this circuit. Reloading restores the browser request language.
Localization_Scope.zh-CN: 切换只影响当前会话。刷新会恢复浏览器请求选择的语言。

Localization_Introduction.en-US: The application and framework use separate embedded catalogs. A scoped bridge resolves shell labels without changing routes or commands.
Localization_Introduction.zh-CN: 应用与框架使用独立的嵌入词典。Scoped 桥接解析外壳文案，不改变路由或命令。

Dialog_Body.en-US: The close button is provided by the framework text catalog.
Dialog_Body.zh-CN: 关闭按钮的文案来自框架词典。
